text_ar:
قَالَ مَالِكٌ وَقَالَ طَلْحَةُ بْنُ مُصَرِّفٍ قَالَ الْهُزَيْلُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ
أَبُو بَكْرٍ كَانَ يَتَأَمَّرُ عَلَى وَصِيِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَدَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَهْدًا فَخَزَمَ أَنْفَهُ بِخِزَامٍ
text_ar_search:
قال مالك وقال طلحة بن مصرف قال الهزيل بن شرحبيل
أبو بكر كان يتأمر على وصي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ود أبو بكر أنه وجد من رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عهدا فخزم أنفه بخزام
text_en: It was narrated from Malik bin Mighwal that Talhah bin Musarrif said: “I said to Abdullah bin Abu Awfa: 'Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) make a will concerning anything?' He said: 'No.' I said: 'How come he told the Muslims to make wills?' He said: 'He enjoined (them to adhere to) the book of Allah (SWT).” Malik said: “Talhah bin Musarrif said: 'Huzail bin Shurahbil said: “Abu Bakr was granted leadership according to the will of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?” (Rather) Abu Bakr wished that the found a covenant (in that regard) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so he could fetter his nose with a (camel's) nose ring.”
text_id: [Malik] berkata; [Thalhah bin Musharrif] berkata, [Al Huzail bin Syurhabil] berkata; "Apakah [Abu Bakar] pernah berkonspirasi mengenai wasiat Rasulullah?" Abu Bakar menginginkan bahwa dirinya menemukan dari Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam sebuah janji, lalu ia mengikat hidungnya dengan seutas tali.
